The format of the tournament consisted of a three [[Round-robin tournament|round-robins]] followed by a 5-team playoff round. [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] unsuccessfully defended its [[1988–89 Honduran Liga Nacional|1989 title]] losing in a replay match to [[F.C. Motagua|Motagua]]. [[Real C.D. España]] won the title [https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hondhist.html RSSSF.com – Honduras - Final Tables 1965/66-1994/95] – 11 December 2009 defeating in the final [[F.C. Motagua|C.D. Motagua]].
